name: Building Standard Law + AIJ standards (Japan)
description: The Japanese pack (alpha 9 track C19). Loads by the Building Standard Law Enforcement Order Art. 82-88 and the MLIT/MOC notifications: the long-term and short-term combinations of Art. 82 (G + P, G + P + 0.7S in heavy-snow areas; G + P + S, + W, + K with 0.35S in heavy-snow areas), the floor live loads of Art. 85 for slabs, frames and the seismic force separately (residential 1800/1300/600 N/m² ...; the frames' value by the live load method frameValue and the seismic weight by use), the snow load of Art. 86 (20 N/m² per cm and m of depth in ordinary areas, the roof shape factor √cos(1.5β)), the wind pressure of Art. 87 and Notification 1454 (q = 0.6 E V0², E = Er² Gf with the terrain categories I-IV, Zb, ZG, α, Gf by height, Cpe 0.8 kz windward and -0.4 leeward, V0 30-46 m/s by municipality), and the seismic force of Art. 88 and Notification 1793 (Qi = Ci ΣWi, Ci = Z Rt Ai C0, C0 0.2 for the primary design and 1.0 for the required horizontal capacity, Z 0.7-1.0 by region, Rt by the soil type 1-3 with Tc 0.4/0.6/0.8 s, Ai = 1 + (1/√αi - αi) 2T/(1 + 3T), T = h (0.02 + 0.01 α)). The primary design (allowable stress calculation): long-term and short-term allowable stresses of concrete (Fc/3, 2Fc/3, fs), bars SD295-SD490 and steel (F/1.5, F) by the AIJ RC and steel standards, the cracked elastic section with n = 15 and the allowable shear b j (α fs + 0.5 wft (pw - 0.002)); the layered drift 1/200, the stiffness ratio Rs >= 0.6 and the eccentricity ratio Re <= 0.15 with Fs and Fe. The ultimate horizontal capacity check: Qun = Ds Fes Qud with Ds by material, member rank FA-FD (RC 0.30-0.55, steel 0.25-0.50) and the walls' or braces' share βu, Qu of each storey from a pushover at the storey drift 1/100 (or the largest shear before), Qu >= Qun per storey and direction; the member ranks of RC columns and beams (h0/D, σ0/Fc, pt, τu/Fc, with the mean shear strength Qsu of the AIJ form) and of steel by the width-thickness ratios. Bars D10-D41 (JIS G 3112) by their nominal diameters; SI. What it does not set (the ultimate strength design of members, AIJ detailing, foundations, timber, the special investigations of tall buildings) is the parent's (ACI 318-19, AISC 360-22, ASCE 7-22) and the report names it. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md, to be checked against the printed law, notifications and standards.
